Messages.Author: badger
Messages.Body:
Dear LSJ:

1) Powerbase Mexico City. Can I pay this card on my master phase, then
using a Sabbat vamp I control, immediately steal the blood for myself?
I posted this question a couple weeks ago, but I had trouble with my
server so I missed your answer.

2) Bang Nakh. The official rulings state "these are not hand strikes".
Does that mean a minion with inherent hand damage +1 does not apply that
modifier to his bang nakh strikes? Or is the clarification only
applicable to combat cards which reduce the opposing minion's options to
hand strikes only. So that if my vamp's in combat with a vamp using
Bang Nakh and I play a combat card that prevents the opposing vamp from
using anything other than hand strikes, he cannot use the bang nakh.

Thanks much,

Badger

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
badger wrote:
> Dear LSJ:
> 1) Powerbase Mexico City. Can I pay this card on my master phase, then
> using a Sabbat vamp I control, immediately steal the blood for myself?

No. You cannot take (D) actions against yourself or cards that you
control (unless implied by card text - see Rampage).

> 2) Bang Nakh. The official rulings state "these are not hand strikes".
> Does that mean a minion with inherent hand damage +1 does not apply that
> modifier to his bang nakh strikes?

No. Bang Nakh does damage based on the striking minion's hand damage,
so modifiers to the striking minion's hand damage would apply.

> Or is the clarification only
> applicable to combat cards which reduce the opposing minion's options to
> hand strikes only. So that if my vamp's in combat with a vamp using
> Bang Nakh and I play a combat card that prevents the opposing vamp from
> using anything other than hand strikes, he cannot use the bang nakh.

Correct. Also, he cannot use cards which modify the damage from a
hand strike - like Claws - when striking with the Bang Nakh.
